items.uz: Notiq o'z nutqini kuchli metafora bilan boshladi.
items.en: The speaker began his/her speech with a powerful metaphor.

items.uz: Ishontirish san'ati mantiq va hissiyotni uyg'un tarzda birlashtiradi.
items.en: The art of persuasion harmoniously combines logic and emotion.

items.uz: Uning nutqi tinglovchilarni chuqur mulohazaga chorladi.
items.en: His/her speech called the listeners to deep reflection.

items.uz: Har bir so'z ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlangan edi.
items.en: Every word had been chosen with care.

items.uz: Bu chiqish auditoriyaning qalbiga yo'l topdi.
items.en: This speech found its way to the audience's heart.

items.uz: Notiq argumentlarini izchil tartibda bayon etdi.
items.en: The speaker presented his/her arguments in a coherent order.

items.uz: Ishonarli nutq aniq dalillarga tayanadi.
items.en: A convincing speech relies on clear evidence.

items.uz: U qarshi tomonning dalillarini mohirona rad etdi.
items.en: He/she skillfully refuted the opposing side's arguments.

items.uz: Bu nutq tarixda eng ta'sirchan chiqishlardan biri sifatida qoldi.
items.en: This speech remained one of the most influential in history.

items.uz: Notiqning ovoz ohangi tinglovchilarga kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
items.en: The speaker's tone of voice had a strong effect on the listeners.

items.uz: Har bir jumla o'z vazifasini bajardi.
items.en: Every sentence served its purpose.

items.uz: Bu chiqishdan so'ng auditoriya uzoq alqishlarga cho'mdi.
items.en: After this speech, the audience burst into long applause.

items.uz: Ariza belgilangan tartibda ko'rib chiqilishi so'raladi.
items.en: It is requested that the application be reviewed in the established order.

items.uz: Yuqorida ko'rsatilgan hujjatlar ushbu arizaga ilova qilinadi.
items.en: The documents indicated above are attached to this application.

items.uz: Ushbu qaror qonun hujjatlariga muvofiq qabul qilindi.
items.en: This decision was made in accordance with legal documents.

items.uz: Belgilangan muddat ichida javob berilishi lozim.
items.en: A response must be given within the established period.

items.uz: Ariza beruvchi barcha talablarga rioya qilishi shart.
items.en: The applicant is required to comply with all requirements.

items.uz: Ushbu hujjat tegishli idora tomonidan tasdiqlanishi kerak.
items.en: This document must be approved by the relevant authority.

items.uz: Yuqoridagilarga asosan, quyidagi qaror qabul qilindi.
items.en: Based on the above, the following decision was made.

items.uz: Murojaat qonunda belgilangan tartibda ko'rib chiqiladi.
items.en: The petition will be reviewed in the order established by law.

items.uz: Ushbu bitim tomonlarning o'zaro roziligi bilan tuzildi.
items.en: This agreement was concluded with the mutual consent of the parties.

items.uz: Barcha bandlar qonun talablariga muvofiqlashtirilgan.
items.en: All clauses have been harmonized with legal requirements.

items.uz: Ushbu ariza rad etilgan taqdirda, sababi yozma bildiriladi.
items.en: Should this application be rejected, the reason will be communicated in writing.

items.uz: Hujjat ikki nusxada tuzilib, imzolangan.
items.en: The document was drawn up in two copies and signed.

items.uz: Ushbu nazariya keyingi tadqiqotlar uchun asos bo'lib xizmat qiladi.
items.en: This theory serves as a basis for further research.

items.uz: Muallif o'z tezisini asosli dalillar bilan isbotlashga harakat qilgan.
items.en: The author has attempted to prove his/her thesis with well-founded arguments.

items.uz: Bu yondashuv mavjud paradigmaga jiddiy tahdid solmoqda.
items.en: This approach poses a serious challenge to the existing paradigm.

items.uz: Nazariy asoslar amaliy tadqiqotlar bilan uyg'unlashtirilishi lozim.
items.en: Theoretical foundations must be harmonized with practical research.

items.uz: Ushbu tushuncha turli olimlar tomonidan har xil talqin etiladi.
items.en: This concept is interpreted differently by various scholars.

items.uz: Tadqiqotning uslubiy asoslari batafsil yoritilgan.
items.en: The methodological foundations of the research are elaborated in detail.

items.uz: Bu nazariya amaliyotda o'z tasdig'ini topdi.
items.en: This theory found its confirmation in practice.

items.uz: Muallifning xulosalari keng muhokamalarga sabab bo'ldi.
items.en: The author's conclusions caused wide discussions.

items.uz: Ushbu maqola muammoning kontseptual jihatlarini tahlil qiladi.
items.en: This article analyzes the conceptual aspects of the problem.

items.uz: Ilmiy bahs davomida qarama-qarshi fikrlar ilgari surildi.
items.en: Contrasting views were put forward during the scholarly debate.

items.uz: Bu nazariy model murakkab hodisalarni soddalashtirib tushuntiradi.
items.en: This theoretical model explains complex phenomena in a simplified way.

items.uz: Keyingi tadqiqotlar ushbu bo'shliqni to'ldirishi kutilmoqda.
items.en: Future research is expected to fill this gap.

items.uz: Mehnat qilmagan, rohat ko'rmaydi.
items.en: He who doesn't work doesn't enjoy comfort (no pain, no gain).

items.uz: Ko'zdan uzoq bo'lgan, ko'ngildan ham uzoq.
items.en: Out of sight, out of mind.

items.uz: Tilga tuz qo'ymoq kerak.
items.en: One must season one's tongue with salt (choose words carefully).

items.uz: Sabr tagi - sariq oltin.
items.en: Beneath patience lies golden gain.

items.uz: Ustiga tuz sepdi.
items.en: He/she rubbed salt into the wound (made things worse).

items.uz: Tovba, bu ishning tagida ne bor ekan.
items.en: Goodness, who knew what was really behind this matter.

items.uz: Yetti o'lchab, bir kes.
items.en: Measure seven times, cut once.

items.uz: Bir yoqadan bosh chiqarishdi.
items.en: They spoke with one voice (acted in unity).

items.uz: Sichqonning ini yo'q, tegirmon oshiqmish.
items.en: A mouse without a hole claims to want a mill (biting off more than one can chew).

items.uz: Ko'p bilgan ko'p yashamaydi, ko'p yashagan ko'p biladi.
items.en: It's not the wise who live long, but the long-lived who become wise.

items.uz: Suvni loyqalatmoq.
items.en: To muddy the waters (stir up trouble deliberately).

items.uz: Aql yoshda emas, boshda.
items.en: Wisdom isn't in age, it's in the mind.

items.uz: U ichki bir g'ashlik bilan javob qaytardi.
items.en: He/she responded with an inner sense of irritation.

items.uz: Uning ko'ngli allaqanday noaniqlik bilan to'lgan edi.
items.en: His/her heart was filled with a vague uneasiness.

items.uz: Bu voqea unda chuqur iz qoldirdi.
items.en: This event left a deep mark on him/her.

items.uz: U o'zini na quvongan, na xafa his qildi.
items.en: He/she felt neither joyful nor sad.

items.uz: Ichki bir sukunat uni o'rab oldi.
items.en: An inner silence enveloped him/her.

items.uz: Uning yuragida ikkilanish va umid aralash edi.
items.en: In his/her heart, doubt and hope were intertwined.

items.uz: Bu holat unga g'alati, tushuntirib bo'lmas tuyg'u bag'ishladi.
items.en: This state gave him/her a strange, inexplicable feeling.

items.uz: U o'z his-tuyg'ularini boshqarishga harakat qildi.
items.en: He/she tried to control his/her emotions.

items.uz: Yolg'izlik uni asta-sekin o'ziga tortdi.
items.en: Loneliness gradually drew him/her in.

items.uz: Uning ko'zlarida chuqur bir ma'yuslik seziluvdi.
items.en: A deep melancholy could be sensed in his/her eyes.

items.uz: Bu kayfiyat o'zgarishi hech kimga sezilmadi.
items.en: This change in mood went unnoticed by anyone.

items.uz: U ichki tinchlikni qidirib, uzoq yo'l bosdi.
items.en: He/she traveled a long way searching for inner peace.
